views.label: Hero
views.note: The default: a whirl of e’s in counterflow, neighboring spokes running in and out, turned into four quarters.

views.label: Detail, 3×
views.note: The eye, where each e grows from nothing as it leaves the center.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: Toward the rim: every e stretched to its ellipse with an even gap all around.

views.label: Spokes
views.note: Straight spokes, the quadrant reflected rather than turned.

views.label: Petals
views.note: Six spokes a quadrant, packed tighter, so the tokens close into petals.

views.label: Lens
views.note: The burst squashed flat into a lens.

views.label: Inhale
views.note: Straight spokes flowing inward, the e’s shrinking into the eye.

views.label: Counterflow
views.note: Spokes in step, not staggered, each running against its neighbours.

views.label: Direction: normal
views.note: The whirl with every spoke flowing outward together.

views.label: Dark
views.note: Black on black, the lines and e’s in pink.

views.label: Padding: loose
views.note: A wider gap between each e and its ellipse.
